name: 69-r11-slots-placeholders-are-state
concern: #69 r11 clause (iii)：`__slots__ = ()` 与只含 `__dict__`/`__weakref__` 的形态算空
old: return tuple(name for name in names if name not in _SLOT_PLACEHOLDERS)
rationale: 把 `__dict__`/`__weakref__` 占位项也算成额外存储：`WeakrefOnlySlotsDict`/`DictSlotPlaceholderDict`/`BothPlaceholdersDict` 被误拒（`NodeSpec` 是 `__slots__ = ()`，空元组不受影响）。由白盒负控与 normalise 负控的正常 FAILED 行杀死。
